subject: Packages that do not work in shinyapps.io

messages.author: 5917ad7b75a68b8e
messages.subject: Packages that do not work in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi! So I tried using rattle in my app, realized I cannot use it for deploying so I rewrote some things and detached the package, but I am still getting the same error. When deploying, it is still trying to build RGtk2. Are there any other packages that might be causing this to happen??

These are the ones that my app requires:


require(viridis)
require(RColorBrewer)
require(ggplot2)
require(randomForest)
require(rpart)
require(rpart.plot)
require(rms)
library(rsconnect)
require(grid)
require(Rmisc)
require(dplyr)
require(party)
